description: Specifications for future tests. NOT_RUN does not indicate execution.

cases.then: A semantic draft appears before speech ends; one question appears after finalization.

cases.given: Draft with designers as the audience
cases.then: There is one selected audience; an old preview does not reappear.
No question appears until explicit completion.

cases.given: A group final has been received
cases.when: Repeat the final with the same key
cases.then: One group and one transaction.
Text is replaced; prefixes are not duplicated.
Playback stops; late audio chunks are ignored.

cases.given: There is no single current yes/no question
cases.then: Clarification instead of arbitrary agreement.
The UI language does not change automatically; meaning is preserved.

cases.given: Preview is slower than partial updates
cases.then: A compatible preview can appear; there is no starvation.

cases.given: A correction cue has been received
cases.then: The epoch check rejects the old proposal.
The source is unchanged; the new branch is separate.

cases.given: A and B have both been explored
cases.then: B is retained; A is restored.
Payment is marked needs_review, not deleted.

cases.when: Switch to B, then receive A's response
cases.then: No mutation of B and no camera return.

cases.given: Manual edit and final share one revision
cases.then: One commits; the other conflicts and is replanned.
Content is restored; revision increases.
No change without explicit, specifically addressed permission.
Different versions are not merged; there is no ranking.
The same acknowledgement is returned without a second event.

cases.given: A branch was created from revision 4
cases.then: The child snapshot does not change automatically.
The draft store updates, not the whole graph.

cases.given: The camera is moving toward A
cases.then: A new animation starts from the current position toward B, without queueing.
FOLLOW is off; a return button is available.
No overlap; the complete text is accessible.
All actions are available without animation or a mouse.
No remaining tracks, STT connections, or growing queues.
STT receives real PCM16 at 16 kHz, not relabeled 48 kHz audio.

cases.given: A PCM chunk with an odd byte length
cases.then: The unpaired byte is carried over; audio is not distorted.
The committed graph is intact; the partial requires confirmation.

cases.when: One repair runs and fails again
cases.then: No partial commit; the utterance is available as text.
No "saved" confirmation; the draft remains.
Text is available; the graph is not rolled back.
403/404 without content.
No paid requests; open STT closes.
No secret, shell access, or arbitrary tools.
No invented statistics; state a hypothesis/test explicitly.
Result 140, shortfall 20, and a source for every number.
Snapshot, branch, and sensible focus are restored.
The old lease is invalidated; its jobs cannot commit.
No access; cache is deleted; no silent restoration.
Validation rejects the source; evidence is not upgraded.
No TTS request is made; the microphone still works.
